大卫与客厅的计划(David and the the living room P: 一篇关于家庭生活的A2短文:大卫与杰克的经历和小计划。

David thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. Last Sunday, David and Jack went to the family chat. David wrote about the day in the diary. Best of all, grandma's soup recipe is a family secret.
David hopes to visit Chengdu one day. Jack's birthday is in January. It takes twenty minutes to get to the family chat by bike. The committee is granting funds to promising young researchers.
David borrowed a book about music from the park. They took many photos at the living room. The weather was snowy that day. The factory makes children's toys.
The family chat is one of the best places in the city. Life is full of small surprises. David drinks tea after doing sports.
